title: ARD section 3 - AI script entries (Vanilla AI Scripts sheet view, with flag bits)

container.notes: ARD section 3 (AI scripts / battle logics), NOT st2e: u16 scriptCount, u16 unknown, u32 section-relative offsets x (scriptCount+1, last = unpadded end), then scripts = 32 u8 group counts + 24-byte entries, section zero-padded to 16. ARD = standalone *.ard or section 19 of an .ebp (magic FF12AR03, ten u32 section offsets at 0x08; this section = u32 at ARD+0x14). Same binary layout as ard-aiscripts; this spec adds the sheet column mapping and the flag bits.

records.name: aiHeader
records.where: Offset 0 of ARD section 3 (ARD start + u32 at ARD+0x14).

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Section-relative script start; last word = end of script data.

records.name: groupCounts
records.where: Start of script s (section offset scriptOffset[s].offset).

records.name: aiEntry
records.count: sum of the 32 group counts of the owning script
records.where: Script s: entries start at scriptOffset[s].offset + 32, all of group 0 first, then group 1 ... Sheet key <ard>_<script>_<group>_<entry> = entry number within its group.

fields.name: action
fields.notes: Action id: 0x0000+ section 14 action, 0x4000+ AI command, 0x8000+n section 10 package n, 0xFFFF none. See enums-ai-actions.

fields.name: actionParameter
fields.notes: Action parameter (p): percent, seconds, meters depending on the action.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: caseLinkType
bits.notes: How the three cases combine: 0 none, 3 link cases 2 & 3, 6 link cases 1 & 2, 7 link all three. The sampled two-case entry has 6.

bits.name: noInterruptToLowerPriority
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: cannot be interrupted by a lower-priority line.

bits.name: alwaysRunning
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: always run to the target.

bits.name: noTargetWith3PlusAttackers
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: skip targets that already have 3+ attackers.

bits.name: noConsecutiveUse
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: not twice in a row (set on the sampled Renew and remove-augment lines).

bits.name: noInterruptByHigherPriority
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: cannot be interrupted by a higher-priority line.

bits.name: noInterruptByAny
bits.notes: Gambit-word name: cannot be interrupted at all.

fields.notes: Line flags. Bit names borrowed from the gambit flag word (battlepack section 7); probable, not confirmed for ARD.

fields.name: case1TargetType
fields.notes: Case 1 target type ("Target ID"); 0 = unused case. See enums-ai-target-types.

fields.name: case1TargetCondition
fields.notes: Case 1 condition id (class<<9 | invert<<8 | operand); 0 = unconditional. See enums-ai-conditions.

fields.name: case2TargetType
fields.notes: Case 2 target type ("Target ID"); 0 = unused case. See enums-ai-target-types.

fields.name: case2TargetCondition
fields.notes: Case 2 condition id (class<<9 | invert<<8 | operand); 0 = unconditional. See enums-ai-conditions.

fields.name: case3TargetType
fields.notes: Case 3 target type ("Target ID"); 0 = unused case. See enums-ai-target-types.

fields.name: case3TargetCondition
fields.notes: Case 3 condition id (class<<9 | invert<<8 | operand); 0 = unconditional. See enums-ai-conditions.

roundTrip: Field edits inside an entry never move data; edit in place.
Keep the flags word as read unless you mean to change a bit; only caseLinkType (bits 3-5) is backed by a vanilla sample.
Unused cases are all-zero (target 0, condition 0, parameter 0); keep them zero.

Adding or removing entries changes the group count byte of that group, every later script offset and the end offset (24 bytes per entry); re-pad the section to 16 and rebuild the ARD section table (see ard-aiscripts).

Keep script numbering: units point at scripts by index (aiScriptLink0..3) and jump commands 0x4112-0x4115 address the unit's four links; group jump commands 0x4048-0x404F and 0x4116-0x4121 address groups by number.
Action ids 0x8000+n refer to battlepack section 10 package n; when packages are appended or removed there, ARD entries that use them must be updated too.
gaps: The Drive connector returned only the first 10 of the sheet's 50,050 entry rows (A3:Y50052), so value statistics (which flag bits occur, which ids are used) are limited to those rows.

Flag bit names are borrowed from the battlepack section 7 gambit word; only caseLinkType has sample support (0xB0 on the two-case entry). Bits 7, 11 and 14 occur in vanilla (0x0880, 0x4800, 0x00B0) with unconfirmed meaning.

Label conflicts between the sheet and the Toolkit lists: condition 775 (0x0307) is "Furthest" in the sheet but "Nearest" in the Toolkit (the sheet's own Data tab lists 519 = 0x0207 as Furthest); action 16715 (0x414B) is "turn towards party leader" (sheet) vs "turn towards target" (Toolkit); target types 9/10 are "Attacker"/"Future Attacker?" (sheet) vs "Current"/"Auto" (Toolkit).
Which group runs first and how lines inside a group are evaluated (assumed: group 0, top to bottom, like gambits).
Vanilla units fill unused AI slots with script 1 (all sampled units: AI 2-4 = 1); whether script 1 is an empty or shared default script is not shown.
For flag/variable actions ("Flag (t) = (p)", 0x4149 and 0x4155-0x4157) the (t) presumably comes from the case 1 target type (a variable id in the 0x1000+ target-type blocks); not confirmed.
